dslRule:
java.text.MessageFormat.format($message, new java.lang.String[] { $args$ })
=>
java.text.MessageFormat.format($message, new java.lang.Object[] { $args$ })
;;
summary: Replace `new String[] { ... }` with `new Object[] { ... }` when passed as an argument array to `MessageFormat.format()` to avoid reliance on array covariance and make the type explicit.
